normal.1: Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing <anemo>Anemo DMG</anemo>.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> after a short casting time.

plunging.1: Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> upon impact with the ground.

description.0: Weaves memories of lovely dreams, entering a Dreamdrifter state where she floats above ground and dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.
3: Yumemizuki Mizuki will deal <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> to nearby opponents at regular intervals.
Increases the Swirl DMG that nearby party members deal based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery.
Dreamdrifter will end when Mizuki leaves the field or uses her Elemental Skill again.
description.5: "Our dreams touch at midnight, their song ringing on in our hearts."

description.0: Summons forth countless lovely dreams and nightmares that pull in nearby objects and opponents, dealing <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> and summoning a junior member of her kind.
description.4: Follows the current active character. At regular intervals, the Mini Baku will create 1 Yumemikaze Specialty Snack nearby. After a nearby active character picks up a Specialty Snack, if their HP is higher than 70%, the Snack will explode and unleash a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> to nearby opponents. Otherwise, it will heal the one who picked it up based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery. If some time passes without a Snack being picked up, it will explode and release a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of <anemo>AoE Anemo DMG</anemo> to surrounding opponents.
description.6: "If you bury dark emotions for too long, they will become nightmares. With that in mind, why don't we turn them into 'delicious snacks' while we've got the time?"

description.0: When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers Swirl while in her Dreamdrifter state, Dreamdrifter's duration increases by 2.5s. This effect can trigger once every 1s for a maximum of 2 times per Dreamdrifter state.

passive2.name: Thoughts by Day Bring Dreams by Night

description.0: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, when other nearby party members hit opponents with <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <cryo>Cryo</cryo>, or <electro>Electro</electro> attacks, her Elemental Mastery will increase by 100 for 4s.

When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the party, party members have a chance to recover 30% additional HP when using healing foods. The trigger chance for this effect increases with the corresponding character's Friendship Level. (This effect will always trigger if the Traveler is the character consuming healing food.)

When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to 1 nearby opponent for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent is affected by Anemo DMG-triggered Swirl reactions, this effect will be canceled and this Swirl instance has its DMG against this opponent increased by 900% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery.

constellation2.name: Your Echo I Meet in Dreams

description.0: When entering the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point Yumemizuki Mizuki has will increase all nearby party members' <pyro>Pyro</pyro>, <hydro>Hydro</hydro>, <cryo>Cryo</cryo>, and <electro>Electro</electro> DMG Bonuses by 0.02% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.
Increases the Level of Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage by 3.

Picking up a Yumemikaze Specialty Snack from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will both deal DMG and heal, and will restore 5 Energy to Yumemizuki Mizuki. Energy can be restored this way 4 times per Anraku Secret Spring Therapy duration.

constellation5.name: As Setting Moon Brings Year's End

description.0: Increases the Level of Anraku Secret Spring Therapy by 3.
While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl DMG dealt by nearby party members can Crit, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%.
